name: GLA University Online

about.text: Ganesh Lal Agrawal University, known more famously as GLA Online University, was established in 1991 in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, by N. D. Agrawal. GLA University is a privately owned institution of higher education that provides courses in the form of degrees and diplomas.

The university has received the necessary accreditations from UGC-DEB as well as other statutory bodies such as AICTE, NAAC (rated ‘A’), BCI, etc. It has also received a special recognition from the Government of Uttar Pradesh and is a reputed and prestigious university to pursue higher education from.

GLA University has its own online functionary, which aims to provide top educational facilities to students irrespective of location by tapping on virtual technological means for educational dissemination. The university offers online courses in the domains of management, commerce, computer sciences, wealth management, and more.

about.text: GLA University has a very value-rooted approach to education and strives to extend equally insightful and comprehensive learning experiences to students enrolled in the online courses that boost not only their knowledge and skills but also their values.

The university’s online courses are provided to students at very pocket-friendly ranges and are integrated with a number of efficient support features such as merit scholarships, admissions and student support, placement services, and LMS.

facts: GLA Online University has the approvals from bodies like UGC-DEB as well as AICTE (for its technical courses) and is a credible online educational institution.
There are provisions for both diploma and degree courses along with relevant specializations that students can choose from.

The learning support of the university has features like live lectures and recorded lectures (both virtual), webinars, discussion forums, and virtual course materials, as well as systematic curriculum planning and course coordination to ensure smooth learning.
The online programs have placement support as well, and students stand the chance to get placed in companies like Accenture, Capgemini, Samsung, Amazon, Honda, and more.
The faculty at GLA University has extensive hands-on experience in delivering online education and is highly qualified in their field of specialization.
The student support bodies of the university are responsive, cooperative, and prompt in addressing student concerns via online mode itself.
GLA Online University has the approvals from the BCI Government of Uttar Pradesh.

admission.text: The admission process in the GLA Online University is conducted in the online mode. So, there is no need to visit the campus for the admission process. Direct admissions are done on the basis of educational qualifications. The admission procedure for 2026 for the online courses at GLA Online University is as follows:
Step 1- First go to the official website of GLA Online University and register yourself.
Step 2- Fill in the application form carefully with all your personal, academic, and professional details.
Step 3- Pay the fee online as specified in the application form.
Step 4- Upload all the required documents for eligibility verification.
Step 5— Once all your documents have been verified by the admissions authority of the university, you will receive the onboarding details if you fulfill the eligibility criteria.

examination.text: GLA Online University conducts examinations in the online mode. As per the new regulations regarding examinations for online degree courses, the university holds online technology-enabled proctored examinations.
Examination Pattern: 30% Internal Assessment (assignments) + 70% External Assessment (end-term). End-term exams are online proctored (3 hours, 70 marks) across three sections.

faqs.q: Is there placement support for online courses in GLA Online?
faqs.a: Yes, the online courses have placement and professional support facilities and students can seek placements in top MNCs and companies like Capgemini, Accenture, Tech Mahindra, etc.

faqs.q: Do I need to visit the campus for admission to online course at GLA University?
faqs.a: The admission procedure for GLA Online University is mainly completed online.

faqs.q: Is an online degree from GLA University valid?
faqs.a: Yes, being a well-accredited and approved university from bodies such as UGC-DEB, AICTE, and many more, an online degree from GLA Online University is completely valid and credible.

faqs.q: Does GLA University provide online education?
faqs.a: Yes, GLA University is UGC-DEB approved to provide fully online courses at the UG and PG levels.

faqs.q: Does GLA Online University have scholarship facilities?
faqs.a: Yes, there are merit scholarships available for students at GLA Online University.
